# Guest display EDIDs printed by the JetKVM Mini's C builder,
# osvc_edid_build() in components/jetkvm_os_services/os_services_edid.c
# (Mini commit f63bac4). The builder in this package must reproduce them
# byte for byte.
#
# "key" is the KVM public key that the stable serials come from, with the
# formula of video_display_serial() in os_services_session.c:
# (little-endian uint32 of key[0:4] with the low 12 bits cleared) | (height & 0xFFF).
#
# Line format: <width>x<height> <random|stable> <serial, 8 hex digits> <EDID, 512 hex digits>
key EFCDAB890123456776543210FEDCBA980F1E2D3C4B5A69788796A5B4C3D2E1F0
1280x720 random 1A2B3C4D 
1280x720 random FFFFFFFF 
1280x720 stable 89ABC2D0 
1920x1080 random 1A2B3C4D 
1920x1080 random FFFFFFFF 
1920x1080 stable 89ABC438 
2560x1440 random 1A2B3C4D 
2560x1440 random FFFFFFFF 
2560x1440 stable 89ABC5A0 
3840x2160 random 1A2B3C4D 
3840x2160 random FFFFFFFF 
3840x2160 stable 89ABC870
